strongest_angle: Investigation by the Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office revealed that MI5 gave false evidence to three courts and misled watchdogs while defending a violent neo-Nazi informant known as Agent X.

key_facts.fact: The Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office revealed that MI5 gave false evidence to three different courts concerning the violent neo-Nazi informer known as Agent X.
Investigatory Powers Commissioner Lord Leveson stated that MI5 lying to multiple courts while defending a violent neo-Nazi spy is as serious as anything he has ever dealt with.
An investigation by Computer Weekly and IPCO exposed that MI5 had lied to the courts and misled the Investigatory Powers Commissioner's Office regarding Agent X.
In September 2026, the security service formally accepted that it gave evidence based on lies to three courts and that senior MI5 officers were repeatedly dishonest.

quotes.text: The man responsible for overseeing the conduct of the UK's intelligence services has said that MI5 lying to multiple courts while defending a violent neo-Nazi spy is as "serious as anything" he has ever dealt with.
quotes.speaker: Lord Leveson
